title: AGHIP — Analysis of Geospace and High-frequency Ionospheric Propagation
description: Single-HTML research software for HF/VHF/EME propagation and space-weather analysis. Release candidate for independent scientific review, not certified. The accompanying review and tests disclose model limits and unresolved external-validation gates, including the P.1147 Figure 4 discrepancy. Offline numerical operation does not provide live weather observations or official alerts.
